rule: A count only goes down and the coverage floor only goes up. Raising a count or lowering the floor needs the owner. scripts/ci/check-baseline.sh compares these numbers and never rewrites this file.

pmd_exclude_patterns.what: files excluded from the PMD ruleset (the lint baseline; only shrinks)

pmd_violations.what: PMD violations in those files with the exclude list removed (informational, not compared; 31 main, 3 test)
pmd_violations.command: ./gradlew pmdMain pmdTest --continue with the exclude-pattern lines removed from the ruleset
pmd_violations.guard: none; the exclude list is the guard

spotless_unformatted_files.what: Java files a full format run would change (the ratchet vs origin/dev guards changed files only)
spotless_unformatted_files.command: ./gradlew spotlessApply -PspotlessFull in a scratch copy, count changed files

osv_advisories.what: OSV-Scanner advisories over gradle.lockfile (report-only scan; review date is the owner's)
osv_advisories.guard: scripts/ci/scan.sh calls check-baseline.sh osv in the CI job Dependency Scan (fails when the count goes up)

image_scan_findings.what: fixable HIGH or CRITICAL image findings accepted as debt on 2026-10-22 (informational here)
image_scan_findings.guard: none here; image.yml reports the count and the accepted list only shrinks

skip_markers.what: @Disabled, @Ignore, conditional-enable and assume markers in src/test

coverage_floor_line_percent.what: line coverage floor, measured 70.6 percent (951 of 1347 lines) on 2026-11-06 with the local stack, rounded down; only goes up
coverage_floor_line_percent.guard: check-baseline.sh refuses a lower floor; the CI step scripts/ci/coverage.sh enforces it against a real run
